# FontLab Blog

> News, technical writing, and updates from FontLab.

News, technical writing, and product updates from FontLab.

## Main pages

- [Blog](https://blog.fontlab.com/index.md): Latest posts from the FontLab Blog.
- [About](https://blog.fontlab.com/about/index.md): FontLab company history and background.
